#Auto-generated load guard 28: puts HOB/HOC permanents into play to prove the
#engine can construct and resolve them. This catches the FATAL failure mode --
#an unrecognised phase/trigger name yields a null card and kills the engine in
#TestSuiteGame::initGame (Spell(observer, NULL)), as Beorn the Fierce did.
#Cards are referenced by id because many HOB/HOC names contain commas and the
#zone parser splits on commas.
#NOTE: the asserted counts are RECORDED CURRENT BEHAVIOUR, not verified-correct
#rules behaviour. This guards against crashes and silent card-load failure, not
#against a card doing the wrong thing.
#UPDATED 2026-08-19: Mirkwood Pathmaker used to arrive as a 0/0 and die immediately -
#its CDA was written against 'controlledlands', a keyword the engine does not have - so
#this guard had recorded 5 in play and 1 in the graveyard. With the CDA on the attested
#type:land:mybattlefield form it survives, so all six stay in play.
#Covers: Mirkwood, Mirkwood Elk, Mirkwood Meditator, Mirkwood Nurturer, Mirkwood Pathmaker, Misty Mountains Raider
[INIT]
firstmain
[PLAYER1]
inplay:700188,701210,700048,700160,700129,700105
[PLAYER2]
life:20
[DO]
next
[ASSERT]
COMBATBEGIN
[PLAYER1]
inplay:*,*,*,*,*,*
[PLAYER2]
life:20
[END]
